question: Pykara was marked as the first water power station in which state of India?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Tamil Nadu**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pykara** is a well-known river located in the **Nilgiris district of Tamil Nadu**.
 
• The **Pykara Hydro Electric Plant** was commissioned in **1932** and marked as the **first water power station in Tamil Nadu**.
 
• This hydroelectric project was developed to harness energy from the **Pykara River**, which originates from the **Mukurthi peak** in the Nilgiris.
 
• The Pykara Hydro Electric Plant has a total installed capacity of **65 MW**.
 
• The hydroelectric plant is considered a landmark in the development of **renewable energy in Tamil Nadu**.
 
• The Pykara River flows through hilly terrain before cascading down into **waterfalls**, making it suitable for generating hydroelectric power.
 
• The station is operated by the **Tamil Nadu Generation and Distribution Corporation Limited (TANGEDCO).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Kerala**__

 __
 
• Kerala is known for its abundant **water resources** and **hydroelectric projects**, with the Idukki Dam being a prominent example.
 
• The state has a high potential for **hydropower generation** due to its **hilly terrain** and numerous rivers.
 
• Some famous rivers in Kerala include the **Periyar, Bharathapuzha, and Pamba.**
 
 
 
• **Madhya Pradesh**__
 __
 
• Madhya Pradesh has several **hydroelectric projects**, such as the Gandhi Sagar Dam on the **Chambal River**.
 
• It is rich in **natural resources** and is known as the **heart of India** due to its central location.
 
• The state also has major rivers like the **Narmada, Tapti, Betwa, and Chambal.**
 
 
 
• **Odisha**__
 
 
• Odisha houses the **Hirakud Dam**, one of the **longest earthen dams in the world**, built on the **Mahanadi River.**
 
• The state is rich in **water resources** and has multiple hydroelectric power stations.
 
• Odisha is known for rivers like the **Mahanadi, Brahmani, and Baitarani.**
